visuals.name: Sacred Resonance
visuals.description: Beats and rising loudness light a golden sanctuary before a flight through its triangle tunnel. Bass sends plasma auroras along the walls. A drop or 30% volume rise over the preceding three seconds opens four connected paths: red, green, and blue around a gold triangle in the middle.

visuals.name: Sailors Sunset
visuals.description: A psychedelic sunset ocean atmosphere with bass-rippled water, glowing clouds, foam, and sunlit waves reacting to the track.

visuals.name: Screenprint Halftone
visuals.description: The frame lands on warm paper as layered cyan, magenta, yellow, and black ink, with timbre roughening the press and percussion nudging its registration.

visuals.name: Serpent Of Harmony
visuals.description: Mythic serpent woven from intertwining sine spines, iridescent scales, and drifting skin veils that answer every bass swell and treble shimmer.

visuals.name: Shearwave
visuals.description: Live capture bends through persistent traveling shear fronts, with bass pushing the displacement and bright details splitting along each wake.

visuals.name: Shock Wave
visuals.description: A sharp radial shock ring launches from the center and punches outward on each trigger.

visuals.name: Silver Mirror
visuals.description: Live video becomes mirrored silver dots folding around twin vortices: bass breathes the surface, mids twist its folds, and percussion sends gentle ripples through the lattice.

visuals.name: Slightly Wavey
visuals.description: Any uploaded image or live frame is edge-traced into layered sky and foreground motion fields, then pushed upward and outward on the beat.

visuals.name: Slow Reggae Portal
visuals.description: Cinematic organic portal with slow autonomous motion and restrained audio reactivity for relaxed 75 BPM music.

visuals.name: Solar Flare
visuals.description: Fourfold neon plasma rings burn outward from a bright corona, smoothly shifting palettes when loud transitions hit while staying locked in Resonance mode.

visuals.name: Sonic Flow
visuals.description: Curl-noise feedback turns the frame into a sculpted liquid heightfield, swelling and brightening with the track.

visuals.name: Sonic Relief
visuals.description: Audio carves the picture into a shifting bas-relief: bass deepens the surface, mids raise its body, and treble catches metallic edge light.

visuals.name: Sound Weaver
visuals.description: Drift through a tunnel of silver spider silk. Bass swells roll toward you while rising volume sends bright streaks along the threads into the distance. Melody bends the web and treble makes it tremble. Eight red eyes awaken as the song ends.

visuals.name: Spatial Flow
visuals.description: Liquid spatial flow

visuals.name: Spectral Fluid Field
visuals.description: A dark fluid surface blooms with seven spectral color lanes, letting low-end waves push the current while mids and highs inject sharper glowing dye.

visuals.name: Spectral Shutters
visuals.description: Rigid image strips slide strongly to their assigned frequency bands, open farther with amplitude and volume rises, and settle as the music quiets.

visuals.name: Spectrum Displace
visuals.description: Nine frequency lanes bend the frame in different directions, letting bass roll broad waves across the floor while upper detail cuts finer refractive seams overhead.

visuals.name: Spider-Verse
visuals.description: Dive through a scarlet and electric-blue comic-book multiverse. Beats draw luminous webs and impact lines while fractured buildings stretch, sway and light their windows to the music.

visuals.name: Spin Contour
visuals.description: Facet-cut tunnel echoes the provided shader with smooth raymarched cubes that accelerate with volume and glow on loudness lifts.

visuals.name: Star Traveling
visuals.description: Warp-speed starfield with comet trails and nebula blooms around a spinning core.

visuals.name: Stereo Elastic Frame
visuals.description: The live image stretches like a sheet held by the speakers: left and right levels pull their own edges while wide, anti-phase sound twists the frame into a supple ribbon.

visuals.name: Stereo Sway Camera
visuals.description: The frame leans and glides with the stereo image, easing between the speakers like a stabilized shoulder rig.

visuals.name: Summoning Rings
visuals.description: Luminous rings breathe through layered depth, swelling with bass, drifting with melody, and scattering reverb-lit sparks on musical accents.

visuals.name: Swirling Colors
visuals.description: A nice gentle melting pot of swirling colors.

visuals.name: Tempo Push/Pull
visuals.description: The frame breathes forward and back on the beat, turning tempo and low-end weight into a smooth, unbroken dolly rhythm.

visuals.name: Temporal Feedback Ghost
visuals.description: A temporal ghost that smears through time with cyan-to-violet feedback trails.

visuals.name: Temporal Wobble
visuals.description: Hyper-oscillator particles weave into rainbow ghost trails, with bass pressure and stereo drift bending the scene into a liquid time wobble.

visuals.name: Territory
visuals.description: Toxic green and crimson territories press across a living cellular field, with competing frequency bands seizing ground on musical turns and buried colors slowly resurfacing.

visuals.name: Textures
visuals.description: Textures, lets give that stream a little extra depth

visuals.name: The Eye
visuals.description: A visualizer inspired by an eye, reacting to audio features.

visuals.name: The Gambler
visuals.description: Audio-reactive triangular plinko run volume rises drop neon balls, pegs scramble their paths, edge jackpots blast shockwaves across the board.

visuals.name: The Infinite Grid
visuals.description: Cyan grids warp under sub-bass pressure, storing dents that redirect ripples while drops raise spires along the horizon.

visuals.name: The Lonely Mountain
visuals.description: A solitary winter mountain rests above a glassy blue sea, breathing gently with the low mids while bass rolls through the water and long musical changes warm the distant light.

visuals.name: The Mountain Range
visuals.description: Acid-green and magenta raymarched mountains with topographic pulses, neon grid ridges, and audio-reactive motion.

visuals.name: The Triangle
visuals.description: Counter-rotating neon triangle shells bloom into inward shockwaves while bass swells the core, mids tighten the kaleidoscope, and treble electrifies the outer lattice.

visuals.name: Thermal
visuals.description: Live capture stays immersed in a deep FLIR spectrum, where sub-bass and bass rises intensify cold blues while mids and upper transients ignite amber heat.

visuals.name: Time Loom
visuals.description: Live motion unfolds into ribbons of time as bass opens the past, mids bend the weave, and each fresh attack reveals the present.

visuals.name: Tri-Quad Tree
visuals.description: Live video or an uploaded image breaks into a recursive triangle tree, where shards split into four siblings while bass deepens the branching and beats electrify the lattice.

visuals.name: Triangle Facets
visuals.description: Amplitude shapes a stable triangular mosaic while bass and amplitude rises visibly expand the sampled image, with midrange light and high-frequency edges.

visuals.name: Tron
visuals.description: Live capture is split into neon edge and motion corruption passes, then fused into a blue-red-yellow TRON grid that surges with the music.

visuals.name: Try this one seriously
visuals.description: Try this one, seriuosly

visuals.name: Twisted Fate
visuals.description: Fly through a twisting kaleidoscope of liquid chrome and electric rainbow light. Bass swells the tunnel, melodies bend its mirrored ribs, and percussion sends bright reflections racing into the distance.

visuals.name: UKG Skyline Pulse
visuals.description: A neon skyline that steps with UKG swing. Bass builds the city, off-beats flicker short peaks, and vocal chops arc as light trails.

visuals.name: Vertigo Pulse Camera
visuals.description: A raster-space dolly-zoom approximation holds the center while bass pressure stretches the edges and each beat releases the lens.

visuals.name: Volumetric LED Field
visuals.description: A deep lattice of luminous diodes breathes with the low end, carrying onset waves through ordered layers before drops dissolve the display into a radiant turbulent cloud.

visuals.name: Warped Kaleidoscope
visuals.description: Fold live video or an image into a clean radial mirror or a warped mandala, with adjustable segments, source rotation and zoom, and bass-driven movement.

visuals.name: Waveform Orbit Tunnel
visuals.description: A rolling tunnel of raw waveform circles that keeps spawning fresh rings at the camera while older ones drift outward into a neon 3D orbit.

visuals.name: Whip Pan Camera
visuals.description: Treble surges that clear the song’s evolving loudness history hurl the frame through alternating whip pans with a brief directional smear.

visuals.name: Winamp Hyperspace
visuals.description: A classic Winamp-style hyperspace tunnel rebuilt in 3D: rainbow ribbons and star streaks that whip forward, flare on drops, and bend with stereo sway.

visuals.name: Word of Mouth
visuals.description: Recognized words bloom straight from the performer’s mouth, stretching into bright lyric stems that grow broader, bolder, and longer-lived as the voice or music gets louder.
